text:
alex kim: Heads-up — I opened a PR to split the payments module (move gst/tax resources into payments-core) and to pin provider versions at the module level. need a quick sanity check before i push the lockfile regen.

alex kim: main concerns: state move for billing.* resources, provider pinning strategy (minor vs exact), and whether the CI will block due to the new provider constraints.

samir: thumbnails — can you paste the provider block you added? small nit: prefer ~> for minor compatibility unless there's a breaking bug in the provider.

alex kim: sure, here's what i added in modules/payments-core/versions.tf

```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    google = {
      source  = "hashicorp/google"
      version = "~> 4.0"
    }
    kubernetes = {
      source  = "hashicorp/kubernetes"
      version = "~> 2.8"
    }
  }
}
```

maria g: Quick Q: are you hoisting any provider blocks to the root? if not, we'll likely need a lockfile per module or to regenerate the root lockfile after the split.

alex kim: not hoisting. plan is module-scoped pins and then run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` per module and commit per-module lockfiles.

devops-bot: CI:terraform-plan (payments-split) — FAILED — https://ci.internal/redwood/1234 — error: provider version constraints conflict in root and module

samir: ok that CI error is expected until you add the module lockfiles and re-run the root plan. two calls:
- add a docs note in the PR describing the lockfile flow
- run `terraform init -reconfigure` and commit the generated .terraform.lock.hcl files from each module

jin: small heads-up on secrets wiring — payment gateway creds live at `k8s://payments/creds` and the module split will need to keep the same secret path or we need to update the deployment k8s manifest. don't forget the secret mapping in the helm chart values.

alex kim: noted — will keep k8s path identical for now. i'll run lock regen + canary apply in staging tonight (22:30 PT) and post results here. ping me in the morning if CI still fails.

maria g: thanks — also add a canary toggle in the rollout so we can revert quickly if state mv hiccups.

alex kim: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:

samir: lgtm for minor pins, please include a short rollback plan in the PR description.

alex kim: added rollback steps and a state mv checklist to the PR body. starting regen now.
